import json, random, subprocess, sys
random.seed(7)
def run(scn):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/submission/bridge.py'], input=json.dumps(scn).encode(),
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p.returncode: raise SystemExit(p.stderr.decode())
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

R = {"https://a.test":"o1","https://b.test":"o2","https://c.test":"o1"}
for trial in range(200):
    # build streams, each with headers then fin; interleave randomly
    sids = random.sample(range(0,50), random.randint(1,10))
    events = []
    queues = {}
    for sid in sids:
        host = random.choice(['a.test','b.test','c.test'])
        path = '/p%d' % sid
        queues[sid] = [{'sid':sid,'type':'headers','fields':[[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':authority',host],[':path',path]]},
                       {'sid':sid,'type':'fin'}]
    while any(queues.values()):
        sid = random.choice([s for s in sids if queues[s]])
        events.append(queues[sid].pop(0))
    r = run({'routes':R,'events':events})
    # expected: order by fin index
    fins = {}
    for i,e in enumerate(events):
        if e['type']=='fin': fins[e['sid']] = i
    order = sorted(fins, key=lambda s: fins[s])
    # group by origin
    byorigin = {}
    for sid in order:
        rec = [x for x in r['streams'] if x['sid']==sid][0]
        byorigin.setdefault(rec['origin'], []).append(rec)
    for origin, recs in byorigin.items():
        raw = bytes.fromhex(r['origins'][origin])
        pos = 0
        for rec in recs:
            assert rec['offset'] == pos, (trial, origin, rec, pos)
            pos += rec['length']
        assert pos == len(raw), (trial, origin, pos, len(raw))
        # verify request paths appear in FIN order
        text = raw.decode('latin-1')
        idxs = []
        for rec in recs:
            p = rec['cache_key'][3]
            # find request line start
            i = text.index('GET %s HTTP/1.1' % p)
            idxs.append(i)
        assert idxs == sorted(idxs), (trial, origin, idxs)
print("ordering test passed")
EOF
